about: Matching eval (SPEC §8: hand-picked best buddy in the top 3 for ≥ 8/10). Seed data and initial picks by the developer; the director reviewed the full profiles (evals/demo-users-review.csv) and eligible pools (evals/eligible-pools.md) and made their own picks, marked picked_by: director. Viewers and buddies are keys in scripts/seed/demo-users.json.

cases.why: Director: Lena is the best match. Paul was also named, but he is excluded by the mutual age filter (Mira wants 24–38, Paul is 60 and wants 45–70).
Both travel for techno and record shops, both pace-4 night owls with music hobbies; Sophie has the same clubbing plan but is an early-rising gallery person.
